An '''individual''' served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of<ref name="Technical" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Ghorman/Legends|Ghorman]]. During his tenure<ref name="Technical" /> in approximately [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after<ref name="Date">{{FactFile|31|TAR 1-4|Grand Moff Tarkin}} states that the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] took place shortly after [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Therefore, the Ghorman [[Governor/Legends|governor's]] refusal to bow to Palpatine must have taken place around the same [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> the [[Declaration of a New Order|transformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the governor refused to bow to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The Empire later increased Ghorman's taxes and, in response, many [[Ghormanian]] citizens staged<ref name="Technical" /> a peaceful protest<ref name="RA">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> against the Empire's increased taxation at their planet's [[Ghorman's primary spaceport|primary spaceport]].<ref name="Technical" /> Hundreds there were [[Death/Legends|killed]] or wounded<ref name="NEC" /> in the [[Ghorman Massacre/Legends|Ghorman Massacre]] when Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] landed his [[Warship/Legends|warship]] on top of the protestors.<ref name="RA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The governor of Ghorman was mentioned in the [[1994]] magazine ''[[Star Wars Technical Journal of the Rebel Forces]]''.<ref name="Technical" />
